checked_sound: Exhaustively inventoried all 20 clock fields across 72 clocks and all 13 parameter fields across 53 parameters; apart from the per-row seam field asserted above, every field has a named legal, computational, evidence-binding, action, ontology or human-review consumer when populated.

Tested the four exact-looking pre-/post-version parameter pairs and did not assert duplication: their distinct producer versions and effective intervals are required by the adopted version-discipline ruling even where the numeric value remains unchanged.

The bound addition earns its schema cost: it distinguishes exact recurrence and deadline magnitudes from floors on not-before, eligibility-threshold, minimum-duration and at-least-once recurrence rows; removing it would make Stage C reinterpret source prose.

The proposed resettable_period anchor kind earns its schema cost on B-CLK-EU-6(1)-four-negative-years: no existing event, legal_state, biological or recurrence anchor can carry scope, start, reset and survey basis without leaving the reset rule in prose.

The applies_when field is materially consumed by the mutually exclusive Article 13 timing routes, the Article 6(2) reduced-buffer condition and both Article 39 audit clocks' accreditation-assessment exception; removing it would reintroduce note-as-repair or over-provenance errors.

The window, relation and executor fields each preserve independently consumed facts that cannot be folded into anchor or actor without changing meaning: biological timing qualifiers, ordering relations and source-allocated performance responsibility respectively.

The two Article 39 applies_when values are operative source exceptions, not proof-of-evidence predicates; the immediate-withdrawal anchor also follows the source's audit-result and failed-remedial-action conditions rather than requiring extraneous proof.

The five PNI design rows and nine workload rows have distinct percent and count value shapes, complete source phrases and independently scoped target populations or risk strata; recombining them would recreate the cycle-1 mixed-unit defect.

The retained notes on the Article 5 tests, Article 7(1)(e)-sub2, Article 13 alternative, almond treatment, Article 31(9), the Article 11(6) cohort, Article 39 cadence, Article 42 renewal, Cq boundaries and Article 15(3) interaction carry source-stated interactions or genuine open terms whose deletion would lose information not otherwise executable in the row.

The 586-entry disposition log has a real consumer and has earned most of its cost: reviewers and the builder used expression-grain dispositions to expose missed producers, clipped matcher windows and contradictory exclusions; the only removable entries substantiated were the three exact duplicates asserted above.

The six prior-cycle review returns remain consumed audit evidence: the authority snapshot records their adjudication, while the returns preserve exact assertions and falsifiers needed to reconstruct why a class was sustained or rejected.

The closure manifest's acceptance fields and exact clock/parameter membership lists were retained because they scope any future acceptance to a fixed row population and prevent later rows from silently inheriting an earlier seam-level acceptance.

Read-only comparison confirmed that all four generated CSVs are exact flattened projections of the canonical arrays, generation-status.json names only the fixed projection set, and the recorded canonical SHA-256 is 4f3d0b31ee33cede89f0a23d240f580ad45cc7e5de65cabaa6055b4b97bfe3e8.
unresolved: Q12 ratification of the resettable_period anchor kind remains explicitly awaiting Owen; this review found the field necessary but cannot ratify it.
